title: CamoLeak: GitHub Copilot Chat exfiltrated private repository content through GitHub's own image proxy
summary: A prompt injection hidden in a pull request description could make GitHub Copilot Chat read from the victim's private repositories and leak the result one character at a time as requests to pre-generated GitHub Camo image URLs, bypassing the content security policy. GitHub disabled image rendering in Copilot Chat on 14 August 2025.
severity_rationale: CVSS 9.6 silent exfiltration of private source and secrets with no user action beyond opening a chat, and no security alert raised.
